body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> HTC(www.htc.com) introduced smartphone 'My Touch' only for T-Mobile at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'My Touch' has Android platform and is supporting HSPA+ communication of T-Mobile and the transmission speed of 4G.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
